summary: Cash boost via creation of new ‘One Vision’ company More rest breaks to reduce player welfare issuesThe Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) has approved major changes to the financial structure of men’s tennis that will make the total prize money available to the players increase to more than $350m (£267m) by 2028, from $270m this year.The creation of a new company to sell all the tour’s media, commercial and data rights, ATP Ventures, will lead to the investment of an additional $100m in player remuneration including an increased $50m bonus pool, a $25m year-end rankings bonus and $26m player pensions.

stories.title: What history tells us about the Premier League table after 10 games of a season
summary: Past years suggest it is tough to make big positional gains after slow start but that someone now safe will be relegatedThe Premier League is about to enter the most intense phase of its season.

Yet if you hibernated for winter, most clubs would be in roughly the same position no matter when in spring you emerged.Across the past decade, Premier League teams’ positions changed by an average of 2.6 places between matchweeks 10 and 38.
Only 5.5 clubs per season moved by more than three places over the final 28 games, with almost half of the teams (89 out of 200) shifting by a single spot at most.
